cues.en: Instructor: Most of the statistical procedures that are applied in statistics and data science and machine learning are what's called parametric statistics,
cues.zh: 講師：統計、資料科學和機器學習中，大部分應用的統計程序，屬於所謂母數統計，

cues.en: but there are also many non-parametric statistics.
cues.zh: 但也有很多無母數統計。

cues.en: And so in this video, I'm going to describe some of the differences between parametric and non-parametric statistics and discuss the advantages and limitations
cues.zh: 這部影片會說明兩者的一些差異，並討論這兩大類統計方法各自的優點和限制。

cues.en: of each of these families of statistics.
cues.zh: 也就是這兩個家族。

cues.en: Now, there are many different kinds of non-parametric statistics, so I'm not going to actually introduce you to any specific set of non-parametric statistics in this video.
cues.zh: 無母數統計有很多不同種類，所以這部影片不會具體介紹某一組方法。

cues.en: You'll learn about those in relevant places throughout the rest of the course.
cues.zh: 本課其他內容會在相關地方介紹。

cues.en: But I now want to just discuss these different branches of statistics a little bit more generally.
cues.zh: 現在只想比較一般性地討論這些統計分支。

cues.en: So let me start actually by saying what non-parametric doesn't mean.
cues.zh: 先說，無母數不代表什麼。

cues.en: It doesn't mean that there are no parameters whatsoever.
cues.zh: 不代表完全沒有參數。

cues.en: You might think that 'cause the name non-parametric, but it doesn't actually mean that there are no parameters.
cues.zh: 名稱可能讓你這樣以為，但其實不是沒有參數。

cues.en: Instead, non-parametric statistics allow us to relax some of the assumptions about the underlying distributions, typically that the distributions are Gaussian,
cues.zh: 而是無母數統計允許放寬對底層分布的某些假設，通常是高斯分布的假設，

cues.en: or we can relax other assumptions, for example, assumptions about the absence of outliers.
cues.zh: 或放寬其他假設，例如沒有離群值的假設。

cues.en: So there are some kinds of non-parametric statistics that are robust to outliers.
cues.zh: 有些無母數統計對離群值具有穩健性。

cues.en: For example, the Spearman correlation coefficient, which you'll learn about in the section on correlations.
cues.zh: 例如 Spearman 相關係數，相關那一章會學到。

cues.en: And there's another class or like a subclass of non-parametric statistics called permutation testing.
cues.zh: 另有一類，或無母數統計的一個子類，稱為置換檢定。

cues.en: And in permutation testing, we don't actually generate the null hypothesis distribution from an equation.
cues.zh: 置換檢定不是從方程式產生虛無假設分布。

cues.en: Instead, we generate an empirical null hypothesis distribution from the data that we actually measure that we actually acquired.
cues.zh: 而是從實際量測、取得的資料，產生經驗虛無假設分布。

cues.en: And so you'll learn about this in the, I think there's two videos on permutation testing towards the end of the t-test section.
cues.zh: 我想在 t 檢定章末尾，有兩部影片會介紹。

cues.en: So what I have here is a very brief, non-exhaustive list of a few parametric statistical tests and their corresponding non-parametric versions.
cues.zh: 這裡是一份很簡短、不完整的清單，列幾種母數檢定及其對應的無母數版本。

cues.en: So you don't need to worry about memorizing these names right now because you'll learn more about each of these things as we go along in the course.
cues.zh: 現在不用擔心記住名稱，隨著課程進行，會更了解每一項。

cues.en: But I just wanna give you the sense that there are many parametric statistical tests that have a corresponding non-parametric version.
cues.zh: 只是想讓你知道，很多母數檢定都有對應的無母數版本。

cues.en: So the Wilcoxon sign-rank test is a non-parametric version of the 1-sample t-test.
cues.zh: Wilcoxon 符號等級檢定，是單一樣本 t 檢定的無母數版本。

cues.en: And the Spearman correlation is a non-parametric version of the Pearson correlation.
cues.zh: Spearman 相關，是 Pearson 相關的無母數版本。

cues.en: Again, you'll learn more about these terms later on in each individual section.
cues.zh: 再次提醒，後面各個章節會進一步介紹這些術語。

cues.en: But this basically means that if you are trying to do a two samples unpaired t-test but your data do not conform to the assumptions underlying the two samples, non paired t-test,
cues.zh: 基本意思是，如果想做兩獨立樣本、不成對的 t 檢定，但資料不符合這個檢定的基本假設，

cues.en: then instead you can apply the Mann-Whitney U test.
cues.zh: 可以改用 Mann–Whitney U 檢定。

cues.en: So that's what the idea behind this table here.
cues.zh: 這就是這張表背後的概念。

cues.en: And then there's other kinds of non-parametric statistics that are designed to solve different kinds of problems.
cues.zh: 還有其他種類的無母數統計，設計來解決不同問題。

cues.en: It's not necessarily the case that there's a problem with one specific parametric test so then there's a specific non-parametric version.
cues.zh: 不一定都是某種母數檢定有問題，因此才有特定對應的無母數版本。

cues.en: There's also just other categories of non-parametric statistics such as permutation testing and cross validation
cues.zh: 還有置換檢定、交叉驗證這類無母數統計，

cues.en: that don't necessarily have a specific parametric correlate.
cues.zh: 不一定有特定的母數對應方法。

cues.en: Okay, so here is also a non-exhaustive list of some advantages and limitations of parametric statistics and non-parametric statistics.
cues.zh: 這裡也是一份不完整清單，列出母數與無母數統計的一些優點和限制。

cues.en: The good things are listed in green and the bad things, but so what can sometimes be seen as limitations are listed in red.
cues.zh: 好的部分以綠色列出，不好的，或有時可視為限制的部分，以紅色列出。

cues.en: So here with parametric statistics, one advantage is that they're standard and widely used.
cues.zh: 母數統計的一個優點，是標準、使用廣泛。

cues.en: So that's a good thing because it means that if you are using parametric statistics, no one's really gonna question you and say, well, you know, why did you run a t-test here?
cues.zh: 這很好，因為使用母數統計時，不太會有人質疑，為什麼這裡用 t 檢定？

cues.en: Why not do something else?
cues.zh: 為什麼不用其他方法？

cues.en: Because these are standardized and widely used.
cues.zh: 因為這些方法已標準化、使用廣泛。

cues.en: So parametric statistics are based on assumptions.
cues.zh: 母數統計建立在假設上。

cues.en: Again, that's not intrinsically a bad thing, but these assumptions really should be tested.
cues.zh: 這本身不壞，但確實應該檢查假設。

cues.en: Although honestly, in practice, the assumptions underlying these various statistics are rarely tested in empirical data.
cues.zh: 不過坦白說，實務上，很少用經驗資料檢驗這些統計方法背後的假設。

cues.en: I very rarely see people actually rigorously, fully quantitatively legit testing the assumptions underlying their statistics,
cues.zh: 很少看到有人真正嚴謹、完整、定量地檢驗其統計方法的假設，

cues.en: which is actually not such a bad thing.
cues.zh: 其實也不一定那麼糟。

cues.en: Assumptions are often met in data and even when the assumptions are not met, many parametric statistics are fairly robust
cues.zh: 資料往往符合假設，即使不符合，很多母數統計也能相當穩健地容忍

cues.en: to minor violations.
cues.zh: 輕微違反。

cues.en: So as long as the violations of the assumptions aren't so horrible, it generally isn't a problem.
cues.zh: 只要違反假設不是太嚴重，通常不成問題。

cues.en: But when the assumptions are violated more extremely, then the results can be misleading or incorrect.
cues.zh: 但違反更嚴重時，結果可能誤導或錯誤。

cues.en: And one example of this is if you have strong outliers in the data.
cues.zh: 例如資料中有強烈離群值。

cues.en: So really large outliers in the data will violate the assumptions of many statistics like t-tests and ANOVAs and regressions, and you can get incorrect results
cues.zh: 很大的離群值會違反 t 檢定、ANOVA、迴歸等很多統計方法的假設，如果沒有處理，

cues.en: if you don't deal with those outliers.
cues.zh: 可能得到錯誤結果。

cues.en: Okay, other advantages of parametric statistics is that they're computationally fast.
cues.zh: 母數統計的另一個優點，是計算很快。

cues.en: So they're really fast, you can implement them really fast.
cues.zh: 速度很快，能很快實作。

cues.en: Even a smartphone can do a pretty sophisticated parametric, statistical test in no time whatsoever.
cues.zh: 連智慧型手機都能立刻完成相當複雜的母數統計檢定。

cues.en: And parametric statistics are generally analytically proven, and that means that you can show using equations and formulas that these statistics really are the right thing to do,
cues.zh: 母數統計通常有解析證明，表示可以用方程式和公式，證明這些統計方法確實是正確做法，

cues.en: that they really give the best solution to statistical problems.
cues.zh: 確實為統計問題提供最佳解。

cues.en: Okay, so now let's talk about non-parametric statistics.
cues.zh: 接著談無母數統計。

cues.en: Some of the non-parametric statistics are more widely used and widely accepted, but some of the non-parametric statistics are not standard, they're not so often used in the literature,
cues.zh: 有些使用廣泛、接受度高，但有些並不標準，在文獻中不常用，

cues.en: and that means that many people might be unfamiliar with those statistics or they might have heard of them, but they're not really sure if that's the right thing to do.
cues.zh: 表示很多人不熟悉，或聽過，卻不太確定是不是正確做法。

cues.en: Now this isn't necessarily a good thing or a bad thing, but it's just something to keep in mind.
cues.zh: 這不一定好或壞，只是需要記住。

cues.en: Non-parametric statistics generally do not have any assumptions.
cues.zh: 無母數統計通常沒有任何假設。

cues.en: They don't make assumptions on your data sets.
cues.zh: 不會對資料集做假設。

cues.en: And I put no in apology quotes here because this term no assumptions isn't really totally accurate.
cues.zh: 這裡「沒有」加上表示保留的引號，因為說沒有假設，不完全準確。

cues.en: There are some assumptions, for example, about having sufficient sample sizes, having a null hypothesis that can actually be quantified
cues.zh: 仍有一些假設，例如樣本數足夠、虛無假設能實際量化，

cues.en: and that you can gather evidence for or against.
cues.zh: 而且能收集支持或反對的證據。

cues.en: And non-parametric statistics can sometimes be slow and computationally intensive.
cues.zh: 無母數統計有時可能很慢、計算密集。

cues.en: That's not generally the case for all non-parametric statistics.
cues.zh: 不是所有無母數統計都如此。

cues.en: But for example, permutation testing can be computationally intensive.
cues.zh: 但例如置換檢定，可能很耗計算資源。

cues.en: Some non-parametric statistics are not even proven statistical methods, they're just algorithms that people have come up with and they kind of sound good,
cues.zh: 有些甚至不是經過證明的統計方法，只是有人想出的演算法，聽起來合理，

cues.en: which is, again, not necessarily a bad thing.
cues.zh: 這也不一定壞。

cues.en: But there's a difference between running through an algorithm that seems to make sense versus using a method that you can prove mathematically is the right thing to do.
cues.zh: 但執行一個看起來合理的演算法，和使用一種能以數學證明正確的方法，仍有差別。

cues.en: So non-parametric statistics are also appropriate for small sample sizes, where parametric statistics are more likely to break down with small sample sizes.
cues.zh: 無母數統計也適用於小樣本，而母數統計在小樣本時較容易失效。

cues.en: One disadvantage of some non-parametric statistics, not all of them, is that they are based to some extent on randomness, random numbers.
cues.zh: 某些，不是全部，無母數統計的缺點是，某種程度依賴隨機性、隨機數。

cues.en: And so the applying the same method to the same data can give different results, at least slightly different results.
cues.zh: 因此，同樣方法套用相同資料，可能得到不同，至少稍有不同的結果。

cues.en: I will talk more about this in the context of permutation testing towards the end of the section on t-test.
cues.zh: t 檢定章末尾談置換檢定時，會進一步說明。

cues.en: Okay so the general conclusion of this discussion is that you should try to stick to parametric methods whenever possible.
cues.zh: 整體結論是，只要可能，就盡量使用母數方法。

cues.en: They're more widely used, they're analytically proven, and they tend to be just sort of better when the assumptions are met.
cues.zh: 使用較廣泛、有解析證明，而且符合假設時通常比較好。

cues.en: So use parametric methods when possible and use non-parametric methods when necessary.
cues.zh: 所以，可能時用母數方法，必要時用無母數方法。

cues.en: And necessary means that your data justify using non-parametric statistics over parametric statistics.
cues.zh: 必要，表示資料有充分理由使用無母數統計，而非母數統計。

cues.en: So in this video, I discussed the distinction or some of the distinctions between parametric and non-parametric statistics.
cues.zh: 這部影片討論母數與無母數統計的區別，或其中一些區別。

cues.en: It's a little bit hard to make this distinction be super clear and crisp in one video because there are many different kinds of non-parametric statistics
cues.zh: 很難在一部影片中把界線說得非常清楚，因為無母數統計種類很多，

cues.en: and it's a little bit difficult to group them all together to discuss them at the same time.
cues.zh: 有點難全部放在一起討論。

cues.en: So you'll learn more about non-parametric statistics over the next several sections, but I hope you found this video to be a good setup
cues.zh: 接下來幾章會學更多，但希望這部影片能為

cues.en: for those later discussions.
cues.zh: 之後的討論做好準備。
